owner.description: Fleet owner/operator brand shown by the public source; not legal ownership certification.

dp_class.description: Explicit published dynamic-positioning class; DP1/DP2/DP3 hyphenated, NMD notation preserved.

source_url.description: HTTPS URL of a retrieved public source.

retrieved_utc.description: UTC retrieval instant of the row primary source; secondary retrievals are in the manifest.

additionalProperties.description: HTTPS URL of a retrieved public source.

field_sources.description: Each non-null factual field maps to the exact source URL in the provenance manifest.

lay_methods.description: Only explicitly published supported pipe-lay methods; null if not established.

tensioner_capacity_tonnes.description: Published total installed pipe-tensioner capacity, excluding optional equipment. Tonne-force rating as labelled t by source.

max_pipe_diameter_inches.description: Upper published pipe outside-diameter equipment range, not a diameter achieved on a project.

water_depth_min_m.description: Published lower operating water-depth bound for the stated lay methods; not vessel draught.

water_depth_max_m.description: Published upper operating water-depth bound for the stated lay methods; achieved depth records do not establish this bound.

record_water_depth_m.description: Explicit numerical achieved pipelay water-depth record; not an operating capability limit.
